title: Spotify Plus Extension Manifest
description: Configuration for one or more Spotify Plus marketplace extensions

$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema used to validate this manifest

id.description: A unique identifier for your extension

version.description: The current version of your extension

author.description: Authors who worked on this extension

tags.description: Tags used to categorize your extension

api.description: The Spotify Plus API version this extension uses

main.description: Path to the main JavaScript file, relative to the repository root

targetSpotifyVersion.description: Supported Spotify version or range. The marketplace warns when the installed Spotify version is outside the range, however it will not block installation.

preview.description: Path to the marketplace preview image. Supports both static and animated images.

banner.description: Path to the marketplace banner image. Supports both static and animated images.

readme.description: Path to the extension README, relative to the repository root. Must not contain parent-directory traversal. The marketplace falls back to the repository README if this file is missing.

branch.description: Repository branch used to load this extension's files and metadata

permissions.description: Permission identifiers declared by the extension

assets.description: Asset paths or glob patterns, relative to the directory containing the main JavaScript file

native.description: Information about the extension's native Android plugin

Author.description: An author who worked on the extension

url.description: A URL to the author's GitHub or other profile

NativeMetadata.description: Metadata for an extension's native Android plugin

apk.description: Path to the APK file, relative to the directory containing the main JavaScript file

pluginClass.description: Fully qualified name of the native plugin entry point class
